description: Watches a procurement (requires the token edm_…): takes a snapshot now and records the events of correction, new document, suspension, postponed deadline and value, plus deadline notices. The checks are periodic; check the date of the last check in the watch. The notices `prazo_impugnacao` (on the day) and `prazo_proposta` (24 h before) go out once each.

destino.description: HTTPS webhook URL. Ignored for pull and email.
